input: 16 ClinVar records on chromosome 21 (public ClinVar identifiers; INFO dropped) chosen from a REVEL run over the whole chromosome, plus one two-allele record at 21:14982700, a position none of the 16 occupies, its two alternate alleles each carrying a REVEL row, and one substitution written with an unchanged leading base (`CC/CT` for a `C/T` row, the alleles both engines trim before the match): missense substitutions every transcript row of which REVEL scores, records whose transcripts the REVEL rows name in part (the other rows unscored unless no_match), records whose transcripts give different amino-acid changes (the aaalt test), a missense substitution REVEL has no row for, a synonymous, a stop-gained, a frameshift, an intronic and a splice-region record the plugin leaves alone, and a reverse-strand gene

revel-positional-no-match.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --dir_plugins {corpus}/plugin_data --plugin REVEL,{corpus}/plugin_data/revel.tsv.gz,1 [--tab|--vcf|--json]

revel.tsv.gz.generator: plugin_data/revel.tsv.gz: the published file cut with tabix to every record's span plus 10 bases on each side (regions merged), the header lines kept, bgzip-compressed and indexed with tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2, the columns the published preparation indexes; the rows carry the file's values unchanged
revel.tsv.gz.source: REVEL v1.3 with transcript ids (revel-v1.3_all_chromosomes.zip), tabbed, bgzipped and indexed on hg19_pos as REVEL.pm's preparation describes; Open Database License 1.0
